# Generated by "Claude files/tools/apply_bug_fixes_2026-11-16.py" (16 November 2026), from the tables of
# "Claude files/tools/apply_school_reports_2026-11-13.py". Change the tables there and re-run this on a backup.
# Country scope. The five-year school report (DA_Tech_Tree_event.40).
# No scripted effect here takes a parameter: the old DA_SR_line_<school> = { do = grant } chose with a parameter
# which effect it called, and the experience never came.
# No else / else_if either: the num_of_owned_provinces_with ladder (if / else_if) that picked the amount paid only
# its last rung, the base, and never the +100 per five buildings. The amounts are now worked out like the
# "next report" of the Secondary Technologies window (DA_SCH_refresh): count, base, +100 per five.

# Refresh the five experience multipliers (1 + the fake modifier), as DA_Tech_prov.<school> does.
# DA_SCH_refresh (the Secondary Technologies window) calls it too.
DA_SR_refresh_multipliers = {
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Alchemy_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Arcane_Arts_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Mechanics_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Medicine_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
	export_to_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp_modifier_var value = modifier:DA_fake_Metallurgy_exp_modifier }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp_modifier_var value = 1 }
}

# DA_SR_n_<var>: owned provinces with a building of the school's current tier or better (0 at level IV).
# DA_SR_amt_<var>: what the report gives the school now, multiplier included; 0 when it has nothing to report.
DA_SR_amount_Alchemy = {	# Alchemy: DA_Alchemy_workshop line
	set_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes } }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { OR = { has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_0 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_1 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_2 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_3 } }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes } }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { OR = { has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_1 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_2 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_3 } }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_3 = yes } }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { OR = { has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_2 has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_3 } }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_completed.Alchemy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_4 = yes } }
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = { has_building = DA_Alchemy_workshop_3 }
			owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 200 } }
	if = { limit = { DA_completed.Alchemy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 300 } }
	if = { limit = { DA_completed.Alchemy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_3 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 400 } }
	if = { limit = { DA_completed.Alchemy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_completed.Alchemy_4 = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 500 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 5 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 10 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 15 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 20 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 100 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_SR_n_Alchemy value = 25 } } change_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 100 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy which = DA_Alchemy_exp_modifier_var }
}

DA_SR_amounts = {
	DA_SR_refresh_multipliers = yes
	DA_SR_amount_Alchemy = yes
	DA_SR_amount_Magic_Theory = yes
	DA_SR_amount_Mechanics = yes
	DA_SR_amount_Medicine = yes
	DA_SR_amount_Metallurgy = yes
}

# immediate of the report: can a school advance once its amount is in? The amount is added for the question
# (the school page's own rule, DA_AM_school_due_<school>) and taken back; the answer is DA_SR_ready_<school>.
# It also leaves DA_SR_n_<var> for the lines of the option.
DA_SR_prepare = {
	DA_SR_amounts = yes
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Alchemy
	change_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy value = 1 }
			DA_AM_school_due_Alchemy = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Alchemy }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Alchemy
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy }
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Magic_Theory
	change_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Arcane_Arts }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Arcane_Arts value = 1 }
			DA_AM_school_due_Magic_Theory = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Arcane_Arts }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Magic_Theory
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Arcane_Arts }
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Mechanics
	change_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Mechanics }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Mechanics value = 1 }
			DA_AM_school_due_Mechanics = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Mechanics }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Mechanics
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Mechanics }
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Medicine
	change_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Medicine }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Medicine value = 1 }
			DA_AM_school_due_Medicine = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Medicine }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Medicine
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Medicine }
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Metallurgy
	change_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Metallurgy }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { which = DA_SR_amt_Metallurgy value = 1 }
			DA_AM_school_due_Metallurgy = yes
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_Tech_Researching_Metallurgy }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Metallurgy
	}
	subtract_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Metallurgy }
}

# the option of the report (in hidden_effect): the experience. The amounts are worked out again on the day the
# reports are filed.
DA_SR_grant = {
	DA_SR_amounts = yes
	change_variable = { which = DA_Alchemy_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Alchemy }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Arcane_Arts_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Arcane_Arts }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Mechanics_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Mechanics }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Medicine_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Medicine }
	change_variable = { which = DA_Metallurgy_exp which = DA_SR_amt_Metallurgy }
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Alchemy
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Magic_Theory
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Mechanics
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Medicine
	clr_country_flag = DA_SR_ready_Metallurgy
}

# the lines of the report (the option's tooltip). They read DA_SR_n_<var>, left by DA_SR_prepare in immediate.
# Every case is a plain if; the cases exclude each other (level, and the count between two rungs).
DA_SR_line_Alchemy = {	# Alchemy: DA_Alchemy_workshop line
